articles.title: Warning: Two Unpatched Citrix NetScaler RCE Zero-Days Under Active Exploitation
articles.executive_summary: Warning: Two Unpatched Citrix NetScaler RCE Zero-Days Under Active Exploitation. Two new unpatched zero-day vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway appliances that allow remote code execution are being actively exploited in the wild, security firm watchTowr said on September 26.
articles.technical_breakdown: Analysis of incident reported by The Hacker News. The threat involves attack vectors targeting Citrix. Further technical telemetry is developing.
actionable_mitigations: Review firewall and perimeter access logs for anomalous traffic patterns.
Verify all endpoint detection (EDR) agents are updated with latest behavioral signatures.
Audit exposed external assets and apply vendor security patches immediately.
articles.telegram_snippet: 🚨 *CRITICAL Threat*: Warning: Two Unpatched Citrix NetScaler RCE Zero-Days Under Active Exploitation — Impacting Citrix. Immediate patching and log auditing recommended.

articles.title: ShinyHunters uses WAF bypass trick in Oracle PeopleSoft attacks
articles.executive_summary: ShinyHunters is exploiting the Oracle PeopleSoft CVE-2026-35273 flaw by bypassing web application firewall rules using a URL-encoding trick, allowing them to compromise vulnerable servers. This attack poses a significant operational risk to organizations using Oracle PeopleSoft.
articles.technical_breakdown: The ShinyHunters gang is using a URL-encoding trick to bypass WAF rules, allowing them to exploit the Oracle PeopleSoft CVE-2026-35273 flaw. This trick enables the threat actors to evade detection and compromise vulnerable servers.
actionable_mitigations: Apply the patch for CVE-2026-35273 as soon as possible
Review and update WAF rules to prevent URL-encoding tricks
Monitor for suspicious activity and implement detection and log monitoring indicators
articles.telegram_snippet: ShinyHunters is exploiting the Oracle PeopleSoft CVE-2026-35273 flaw by bypassing WAF rules using a URL-encoding trick, posing a significant operational risk to vulnerable organizations.

articles.title: Lunex Stealer Abuses AMD Driver to Disable Security Monitoring and Steal Browser Credentials
articles.threat_category: Ransomware | Data Breach | 0-Day & Exploit | Nation-State/APT | Cloud & Supply Chain | Vulnerability / Advisory
articles.executive_summary: The Lunex Stealer malware targets Ukrainian-speaking users via a four-stage attack chain, abusing AMD drivers to disable security monitoring and steal browser credentials. This activity is part of a wider malware-as-a-service (MaaS) platform.
articles.technical_breakdown: The attack chain begins with a fake CAPTCHA page and uses ClickFix-style Cloudflare verification checks to distribute the Psychedelic Stealer malware via compromised Ukrainian websites. The malware then exploits AMD drivers to disable security monitoring and steal browser credentials.
actionable_mitigations: Ensure AMD drivers are up-to-date and patched
Implement additional security monitoring and logging to detect potential exploitation
Monitor for suspicious Cloudflare verification checks and CAPTCHA pages
articles.telegram_snippet: Lunex Stealer malware targets Ukrainian-speaking users via a four-stage attack chain, abusing AMD drivers to disable security monitoring and steal browser credentials. Update AMD drivers and implement additional security measures to mitigate the risk.

articles.title: Microsoft pauses KB5002907 update after Office license deactivations
articles.executive_summary: Microsoft has paused the rollout of the KB5002907 update after users reported that it deactivated or removed perpetual Office 2016 and Office 2019 installations. This issue poses a significant operational risk to organizations relying on these Office versions.
articles.technical_breakdown: The KB5002907 update appears to have triggered a license deactivation mechanism, leading to the removal of Office 2016 and Office 2019 installations. The root cause is likely related to the update's interaction with Microsoft's licensing system.
actionable_mitigations: Do not install the KB5002907 update until further notice
Verify Office license status before applying updates
Monitor for similar issues with other Microsoft updates
articles.telegram_snippet: Microsoft pauses KB5002907 update after reports of Office license deactivations, posing operational risk to organizations relying on Office 2016 and Office 2019.

articles.title: New x47.c Windows Botnet Weaponizes xAI Grok, AI API Draining
articles.executive_summary: A new Windows botnet leverages AI to maintain persistence, posing a significant threat to enterprise networks. The botnet uses xAI Grok to choose from predefined actions, making it difficult to detect and mitigate.
articles.technical_breakdown: The botnet relies on xAI Grok, an AI API, to select from a set of predefined actions, allowing it to adapt and evade detection. This AI-driven approach enables the botnet to maintain persistence and evade traditional security measures.
actionable_mitigations: Implement AI-powered threat detection and response solutions
Monitor network traffic for suspicious AI-driven activity
Update Windows systems with the latest security patches
articles.telegram_snippet: New Windows botnet uses AI to maintain persistence, posing a significant threat to enterprise networks. Botnet leverages xAI Grok to choose from predefined actions, making it difficult to detect and mitigate.
